notes.title: 🌼MINDHACK 1.2.2 Patch Notes🌼
notes.content:
Hello, Mindhackers! This version mostly fixes bugs and errors from the previous ones.
In the latter half of the patch notes, [b]we’ve also included a troubleshooting guide for players who are on the Mac versions and are having issues with the typing parts.[/b] If this issue concerns you, read that part and, hopefully, it’ll help you.


[h2]Added a button to skip minigames[/h2]

MINDHACK is divided into story parts and game parts with typing sessions. There are also some parts that require you to use the mouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/eb087fd3aa7a0f443a54b044df76a7434ebf9092.jpg[/img]

However, these controls may be impractical for certain users, for example those who are playing on SteamDeck and can’t easily connect a keyboard and mouse to it.

For players who just want to enjoy the story and can’t or don’t want to play through the game parts, we’ve added a button that lets you [b]get through the minigames without any input.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/443c318fcaac5832596de447a748529110b4a7c6.png[/img]

The button will show up if you’re stuck in a minigame for more than 10 seconds, but you can also use it before that by pressing the Escape key.


[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

These are the other fixes in this version.
・Added character art for scenes 2 and 5 of chapter 3; scene 5 of chapter 4; and scene 5 of chapter 5.
・Fixed a bug where the game’s frame would disappear in scene 3 of chapter 5 when loading specific game files.
・Fixed a bug with the mouse controls in the minigame in scene 4 of chapter 5.
・Fixed a bug that made an afterimage remain on screen when skipping after a cutscene was over in the latter part of scene 5 of chapter 5.
・Fixed a bug that made minigames display incorrectly for aspect ratios other than 16:9 in scene 4 of chapter 3, scene 4 of chapter 4, scene 4 of chapter 5, and more.

・Fixed other minor bugs, typos, etc.



[h2]Troubleshooting for the Mac Version: What to Do if the Typing Parts Don’t Work
[/h2]

MINDHACK includes some parts where you have to type on your keyboard with progress through the game.
[b]In order for the keystrokes to be recorded correctly, you need to enter single-byte characters.
[/b]
In other words, if your Mac keyboard is set to Japanese, Google’s Japanese IME, Korean, Traditional Chinese, or Simplified Chinese, [b]the keystrokes, even though they look like normal alphabet letters, are double-byte characters, which will not work in MINDHACK.[/b]

Changing the keyboard’s language to “English - ABC” usually fixes this issue.
If you don’t know how to do that, follow the steps below.



1.
Go to System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources.

(The screenshots shown here are from the Japanese version of macOS and might be different depending on the version you’re using.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/e26b175e03e0ddaeaf157885447688c8072890a7.png[/img]

2.
Click on the “+” button on the bottom left.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/cd74a73bcf0633f21f86031ed93c3b92e3bf6d8c.png[/img]
3.
Select “English” and then “ABC”, and then click on the “Add” button on the bottom right.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/8836387aa59f2b659090ded49f73f3215d39b3e5.png[/img]
4.
Switch to  “ABC” from the language menu on the top right of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/551fe869604ce39249b62a33d8b730467fa19a95.png[/img]
5.
Play MINDHACK and reach a typing minigame part.


—-

The above is for Mac users.
In Windows, typing may not work correctly for different reasons: you have Caps Lock on, your keyboard is set to a double-byte language, etc. Please check your system’s keyboard input.

We’re working on a new chapter of MINDHACK while we keep on making quality of life improvements. Thank you again for playing the game!

With love,
VODKAdemo?

notes.title: MINDHACK Chapter 5 Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/5f0d5d24c00ecdbe0463705779f6a029cfb4152a.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow MINDHACKers!
The latest update adds Chapter 5 to the main story of MINDHACK!

You can access the new chapter from the end screen of Chapter 4 by following one of these steps:
Method 1: Select CASE 4: Scene 5 from CHAPTER SELECT and play Chapter 4 to the end.
Method 2: Choose any save file from LOAD GAME and continue playing Chapter 4 to the end.
Method 3: Start fresh with NEW GAME and progress to the end of Chapter 4.
Feel free to pick whichever method works best for you!

(Note: Certain save files that meet specific conditions might end your Mindhacker journey at the conclusion of Chapter 4. If that happens, use Method 1 to access Chapter 5.)

[h2]Updated features[/h2]
Responding to player requests, the update also includes changes to typing mechanics for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean. They have been updated from the previous command-based system to a typing-style system that matches with the English version. 
Please ensure your keyboard input is set to alphabetic characters. [b]The typing part of MINDHACK must be entered in single-byte alphanumeric characters.[/b]
*Typing mechanics for Japanese and English remain unchanged.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/db5c7c0af26d8cd3b993f46a296635375bb6b793.png[/img]

In addition, MINDHACK now supports Steam Cloud saves! If you’ve played the game on multiple PCs, your save files will now be unified. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1727210/view/525334304789628286]Be sure to check the pre-update precautions here: (URL)[/url]

[h2]To Our Chinese and Korean Players[/h2]

In response to your requests, we are currently reviewing and refining the translations for the entire game. To better convey the charm of the characters, we’ve brought on new translators for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean starting with Chapter 5.

Please note that there might be slight differences in the translations between Chapters 1-4 and Chapter 5. For example, character names, tones of speech, or pronouns used between characters may vary from previous chapters. We’re planning to improve the translations of earlier chapters in future updates, so stay tuned!


[h2]Chapter 5: Hugo Patrick[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/8e9c5245bcc27043287f13f4dd12bf2ce26a58bf.png[/img]

A mysterious figure appears at the MINDHACK facility at night. Could he be a visitor from outer space? His name is Patrick Hugo, and he’s dressed in a spacesuit. Who exactly is Hugo? While he claims to be from a planet called “Earth,” what story do the memories deep within his mind tell us…?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/4e41cbc7b7a450e9cf91866b427ebdb24d55f86c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/bf2f4616871ec8447fbdcc3238d92339d27b725e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/d6635c21172cd1a31f2fc25b32bac2b8b456675f.png[/img]

After completing the chapter, don’t forget to check out the additional materials in the EXTRA screen! This time, we’ve packed in even more content. Enjoy Hugo’s cosmic journey through the supplementary records!

We hope you enjoy this exciting new chapter!

In addition to the main storyline, MINDHACK offers a variety of spin-off contents to further explore each character.

notes.title: Important Notice About MINDHACK Cloud Save Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/688893f76ec7e797108a3f18ef679007669c6709.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow MINDHACKers!
We’re excited to announce that the brand new Chapter 5 of MINDHACK is scheduled for release on March 2, 2025, at 12:00 AM (JST).

[previewyoutube=qUL48-4tak0;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s the MINDHACK Chapter 5 Announcement Trailer. Just a little more patience until spring!



In response to your requests, MINDHACK will also introduce Steam Cloud save alongside the Chapter 5 update.


[h2]What Is Steam Cloud Save?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/80b46066d66f62e19e6fee8f51653974efa8fe88.png[/img]

Steam Cloud save allows you to seamlessly continue your game progress across multiple PCs using the same Steam account.


[h2]Important Notes About Cloud Save Integration[/h2]

As Cloud save is enabled, please keep the following in mind if you play on more than one PC:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/2393171d2dc3d671d46b9613ff3475405a2e7197.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/2870d2303b66dde95ba4452b816c3e7ac8732fad.png[/img]

- Cloud save combines save data from multiple systems.
If you’ve been playing MINDHACK on more than one PC, it’s likely that one of the save files will be overwritten, as all save data will be merged into a single primary file.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/73e91f6581f8a70aa0d1babdc4d3fdad3291971a.png[/img]
The save data uploaded to the cloud will generally be the one with the most recent save date.

[h2]- Save Data Conflicts.[/h2]

However, under certain circumstances, a "save data conflict" may occur. For example, this can happen if a new save file is created while the device is offline. 

A "conflict" refers to a situation where the Cloud save data and the local save data on your device are inconsistent, making it unclear which is the most recent save file.
If a conflict occurs, a Steam dialog will appear, allowing you to choose which data to retain.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/894c956cb1473b807cb5493fbc3c94901b2c6dc0.png[/img]

The selected save file will be kept as the latest save in the cloud, and the unselected one will be deleted. Please carefully review the dates on each save file to determine which one to keep.



[h2]- Minimal impact for single-PC players.[/h2]
If you’ve only been playing MINDHACK on one PC, this change is not expected to significantly affect your save data. However, since Cloud save is a Steam feature, it may still affect other MINDHACK save files stored on the same device. Please be cautious if you share the PC with family members or housemates who also play the game.



[h2]Timing of Cloud Save Synchronization[/h2]

Starting on March 2nd, save files will automatically begin uploading to the cloud when you play the game. You can confirm if the feature is enabled by checking for an icon displayed next to the "Play" button on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/4f553551301830f2dc2ac6f08baed3b4201c8c4c.png[/img]

Key Details:
- Save files are uploaded to the cloud when the game application is closed.
- Save files are downloaded from the cloud when the game application is launched.

You can monitor the current status of cloud synchronization by checking the above-mentioned icon.




We can’t wait to introduce you to the new characters and storylines in March! Thank you so much for your support and for playing MINDHACK. We truly appreciate it.

With love,
The VODKAdemo? Team

notes.title: MINDHACK Chapter 4 now available!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow MINDHACKers!
We are proud to announce that in our newest update, the fourth chapter of the main story has been added! The new chapter can be accessed from the completion screen of Chapter 3, which can be reached...
- by choosing "CASE3 : Scene5" in "CHAPTER SELECT" and finishing Chapter 3.
- by choosing any save data in "LOAD GAME" and playing through Chapter 3.
- by choosing "NEW GAME" and playing through Chapter 3.
Pick any of the above methods you prefer!



With the newest update, MINDHACK now supports Simplified Chinese/Traditional Chinese/Korean. A new feature in the typing sequences has also been added so that players using different keyboards in various languages get the same gameplay experience. (No change has been made for the Japanese and English typing sequences.)
We hope that more players from different parts of the world will enjoy MINDHACK!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/beac5d10463076a6fa5162effb524cf082c17b49.png[/img]

After the great battle with BUGs, Doctor gets a much-needed vacation and enters a room different from the usual debug room. Whatever could await there?
Discover new characters to interact with and new minigames to play on.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083046/6f981aa68f171a4f440af1ac69811bdece7dabd8.gif[/img]

Additionally, several new achievements have been added in the game.
Look back on previous chapters too to find out where to unlock those achievements.
